Subject: Coordinating executive demo — DST / slot rotation edge case

Hi Olivia & Liam,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to get your execs into a short (30–40 min) run-through of Redwood Inference. We want to make sure the right folks can join from each region (US West, Central Europe, APAC EMEA timezone), and there's a daylight-savings wrinkle this week where EU clocks moved last weekend and some calendars are showing mismatched offsets.

Quick ask: can you confirm (1) the names and titles for the ~3 execs who will join, and (2) any hard blackout windows next Tue/Wed (US time) / Wed/Thu (EU/APAC local)? We want to avoid the usual 'calendar shows 10am but actually is 9am' issues.

I'm attaching a one-page availability snapshot and a proposed time matrix (three candidate slots converted across zones). If one looks good, we'll send a calendar invite with both literal UTC times and local times.

Proposed slots (UTC):
- Option A: 2027-05-04 15:00 UTC (US morning, EU afternoon, APAC late night)
- Option B: 2027-05-04 20:00 UTC (US afternoon, EU evening, APAC early morning)
- Option C: 2027-05-05 10:00 UTC (US early morning, EU late morning, APAC evening)

Note: we purposely included UTC to avoid DST translation errors.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa (AM US lead) and Jonas (solutions exec) to align on attendees from our side.

- Karthik

Appreciate the heads up — the EU DST shift did scramble a few meeting invites here. Quick answers:
- Execs: Olivia Chen (CEO), Naveen Rao (CTO), Priya Mehta (Head of ML) — all likely to attend but Priya has a late call window Thu evening CET.
- Hard blackout: Naveen is unavailable 2027-05-04 18:00–20:00 UTC (internal leadership sync).

We prefer Option C if it doesn't push Priya past midnight in India — Option B's APAC slot is 05:00 IST which is a hard no. Option C looks best for us.

I'll check with Liam on his side and confirm by EOD.

Thanks,
Olivia

I can do 2027-05-05 10:00 UTC (that's 12:00 CEST for me). Two operational notes:
1) If Priya is in IST, 10:00 UTC is 15:30 IST — that should be within reasonable hours.
2) Please include a short agenda and call dial-in in the invite; let's cap live demos to 20 minutes and leave 15 for Q&A so exec time is respected.

Agenda suggestion:
- 5 min — intros & goals
- 20 min — tailored demo (inference throughput + routing fallbacks)
- 10 min — integrations & security (Jonas)
- 10 min — next steps & close

I'll tentatively block the slot on my calendar pending official invite.

— Jonas

Great — looks like Option C is the winner. Two quick operational items before I send the invite:
1) Olivia — can you confirm Priya's timezone preference (IST vs GMT+5:30) and whether she needs the invite in UTC-only or local times too? Some of GreenMesh's calendars earlier rendered the wrong hour when we only included local times.
2) Rishi — please prepare a one-slide security summary to attach (SOC2 scope, data retention, KMS integrations). Jonas — I'll ask you to keep the integrations piece tight to 7–10 minutes.

I'll generate a calendar invite with explicit UTC and each attendee's local time in the description and include the attachments. Expect invite in ~30 minutes.

-Karthik
